usage.name: usage
usage.label: HOW IT WORKS
usage.title: From a prompt to a video clip

items.title: Describe or upload
items.description: Use text-to-video, or switch to image-to-video and upload a PNG, JPEG or WebP reference (up to 10MB).

items.title: Choose settings
items.description: Set resolution, duration and aspect ratio. The tool shows the estimated credit cost before you submit.

items.title: Generate and wait
items.description: Sign in to submit. Stay on this page while the job runs; download the clip from task history when it succeeds.

feature.name: feature
feature.title: What you can do, and what to expect
feature.description: Video generation is asynchronous. Plan time to review the output before publishing.

items.title: Text to video
items.description: Describe motion, camera and lighting in plain language.

items.title: Image to video
items.description: Upload a still image as the visual starting point.

items.title: Multiple models
items.description: Choose Basic, Seedance 2 Fast, Seedance 2 or Wan 2.6. Each model has its own credit rate.

items.title: Resolution & duration
items.description: Pick 480p–1080p and clip length. Longer clips use more credits.

items.title: Task history
items.description: Recent jobs appear below the tool with status updates and download links.

items.title: Credit estimate
items.description: Cost is shown before submit; failed jobs refund reserved credits when confirmed.

items.title: Review before publish
items.description: Check motion, text and rights before using the clip commercially.

items.title: How long does generation take?
items.description: Often one to three minutes depending on duration and provider load. The page polls status automatically while it stays open.

items.title: Can I leave the page?
items.description: For local testing, keep the tab open until the job completes. Production sites can add a maintenance cron to recover long jobs when users navigate away.

items.title: Do I need to sign in?
items.description: Yes. Credits are reserved when you submit and settled when the job succeeds or fails.

items.title: What image formats are supported for image-to-video?
items.description: PNG, JPEG and WebP up to 10MB. Files are validated on upload.

items.title: What if generation fails?
items.description: Reserved credits are released when the task is marked failed. You can retry with a revised prompt.

cost.title: Video generation costs
paragraphs: Credits depend on the model, resolution and duration. Basic 480p/5s starts at 20 credits; Seedance 2 and Wan 2.6 cost more.
The Create button shows the exact estimate before you submit. Failed jobs refund reserved credits.
If your balance is low, open pricing from the dialog or visit the pricing page.
